summary: The dossier window gains Export signed evidence, opening the same review as every evidence export. The bundle is the existing oo-evidence-1 format: the dossier's joined articles are the items under the Merkle root and the dossier as the page shows it rides in manifest.dossier, covered by the Ed25519 signature, so verify_bundle and scripts/verify_evidence.py check it unchanged. It lists the rails carried and not, says when a dossier larger than the page's 5,000-id bound is carried in part, and carries the licence lines that apply with their signals (OSM's credit and the ODbL line under Q823 = a). Floats are written as decimal text so a browser-saved file still verifies; which Wikipedia pages the install follows is left out; the review names what the dossier part reveals in plaintext. A bundle without a dossier is unchanged. 7 strings x12. No network, schema or key change.
